name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> exactly (domain=dialog, descriptor=blink_phase_oscillator). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to its own/another address). Name accurately reflects both role (free-running blink-phase counter) and the data form (an oscillator = a scalar phase counter), matching all three xref sites verified by decompilation.
purpose: Dialog cursor/border blink-phase counter: a free-running phase index advanced off the BIOS midnight tick (0:046C), read by the dialog repaint code to alternate the selected corner/box sprite frame (highlight-blink animation).
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS dword. Two writers share it with different wrap moduli. fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint (settings/options dialog) increments once per >3-tick step (vs tick_latch @ 0x53C17) and wraps 0<->1 (CMP ...,2), so the selected border corner toggles between sprite frame A and A+1. fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop (text / Yes-No prompt) increments once per >=2-tick step and wraps 0..3 (CMP ...,4); the Yes/No highlight uses value/2 as its 0/1 frame offset, and the value is reset to 0 on both typewriter exit paths (Esc -> -1, confirm -> 1). Read-only consumer fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders adds the value to the sprite index of the currently-selected corner. Accessed only as a 32-bit dword at every site (INC/CMP/MOV dword ptr [0x53C13]).
element_semantics: Single scalar phase index. Effective range 0..1 in the settings-dialog writer and 0..3 in the typewriter writer (consumed there as value/2 -> 0/1). Used as an additive sprite-frame offset for the currently-selected dialog corner/box to produce the blink highlight.
notes: Memory at 0x53C13 reads all-zero (zero-bss). 10 xref sites across 3 functions (fd2_wait_input_with_dialog_repaint @0x178d7, fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders @0x17a85, fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop @0x19b30); both READ and WRITE present -> not const. Partner latch data_fd2_dialog_blink_phase_oscillator_tick_latch @ 0x53C17 is a separate symbol (4 bytes later), not modified here. src comment block (input.c lines 744-763) was already precise/accurate/ASCII -> kept verbatim, src not edited. Ghidra data plate was null -> created a concise plate reflecting the src conclusion. No logic/equivalence concerns found.
